sanskrit: pra ye gāvo na bhūrṇayas tveṣā ayāso akramuḥ | ghnantaḥ kṛṣṇām apa tvacam ||
english: They who, like impetuous cattle, have boldly stridden forth — the fierce, eager ones — smiting off the dark skin.

sanskrit: suvitasya manāmahe 'ti setuṁ durāvyam | sāhvāṁso dasyum avratam ||
english: We meditate upon prosperous welfare, overcoming the hard-to-cross barrier, overpowering the Dasyu who observes no sacred rites.

sanskrit: śṛṇve vṛṣṭer iva svanaḥ pavamānasya śuṣmiṇaḥ | caranti vidyuto divi ||
english: The roar of the vigorous Pavamāna is heard like the sound of rain; the lightnings move about in the sky.

sanskrit: ā pavasva mahīm iṣaṁ gomad indo hiraṇyavat | aśvāvad vājavat sutaḥ ||
english: Flow in, purifying thyself, with great refreshment, O Indu — refreshment rich in cattle, rich in gold, rich in horses, rich in food, thou the pressed one.

sanskrit: sa pavasva vicarṣaṇa ā mahī rodasī pṛṇa | uṣāḥ sūryo na raśmibhiḥ ||
english: Purify thyself, all-beholding one; fill the two great worlds — as Uṣas, as the Sun with rays.

sanskrit: pari ṇaḥ śarmayantyā dhārayā soma viśvataḥ | sarā raseva viṣṭapam ||
english: Flow around us on all sides, O Soma, with a sheltering stream — even as a swiftly running juice flows through the firmament.

sanskrit: janayan rocanā divo janayann apsu sūryam | vasāno gā apo hariḥ ||
english: Generating the bright spaces of heaven, generating the Sun within the waters, the tawny one clothing himself with the cows and the waters.

sanskrit: eṣa pratnena manmanā devo devebhyas pari | dhārayā pavate sutaḥ ||
english: This god, pressed out, purifies himself with a stream surpassing the other gods, with the ancient hymn of praise.

sanskrit: vāvṛdhānāya tūrvaye pavante vājasātaye | somāḥ sahasrapājasaḥ ||
english: For him who is ever waxing strong, for the swift one, for the winning of prizes, the Somas of thousandfold splendour flow, purifying themselves.

sanskrit: duhānaḥ pratnam it payaḥ pavitre pari ṣicyate | krandan devām̐ ajījanat ||
english: Milking out the ancient milk, he pours himself around the filter; roaring, he has given birth to the gods.

sanskrit: abhi viśvāni vāryābhi devām̐ ṛtāvṛdhaḥ | somaḥ punāno arṣati ||
english: Soma, self-purifying, flows toward all desirable things, toward the gods who magnify the sacred order.

sanskrit: goman naḥ soma vīravad aśvāvad vājavat sutaḥ | pavasva bṛhatīr iṣaḥ ||
english: Purify thyself, O Soma, pressed out with refreshment rich in cattle, rich in heroes, rich in horses, rich in food — with abundant refreshments.

sanskrit: yo atya iva mṛjyate gobhir madāya haryataḥ | taṁ gīrbhir vāsayāmasi ||
english: Him who is polished with cows like a steed for exhilaration — the beloved one — we clothe with hymns.

sanskrit: taṁ no viśvā avasyuvo giraḥ śumbhanti pūrvathā | indum indrāya pītaye ||
english: All our songs, eager for favour, adorn him as of old — the drop, for Indra to drink.

sanskrit: punāno yāti haryataḥ somo gīrbhiḥ pariṣkṛtaḥ | viprasya medhyātitheḥ ||
english: The beloved Soma moves, self-purifying, adorned by the hymns of the inspired sage, of Medhyātithi.

sanskrit: pavamāna vidā rayim asmabhyaṁ soma suśriyam | indo sahasravarcasam ||
english: O Pavamāna, grant us wealth — beautiful wealth, O Soma, O Indu — of thousandfold brilliance.

sanskrit: indur atyo na vājasṛt kanikranti pavitra ā | yad akṣār ati devayuḥ ||
english: The drop, like a prize-winning steed, neighing, pours itself through the filter — the pious one flowing out beyond.

sanskrit: pavasva vājasātaye viprasya gṛṇato vṛdhe | soma rāsva suvīryam ||
english: Purify thyself for the winning of prizes, for the growth of the inspired singer who praises thee; O Soma, bestow heroic strength.

sanskrit: pra ṇa indo mahe tana ūrmiṁ na bibhrad arṣasi | abhi devām̐ ayāsyaḥ ||
english: For us, O Indu, thou flowest forth bearing a wave toward the great web; thou, the eager one, strivest toward the gods.

sanskrit: matī juṣṭo dhiyā hitaḥ somo hinve parāvati | viprasya dhārayā kaviḥ ||
english: Soma the seer, pleasing to the mind, directed by thought, is urged on from afar — with the stream of the inspired sage.

sanskrit: ayaṁ deveṣu jāgṛviḥ suta eti pavitra ā | somo yāti vicarṣaṇiḥ ||
english: This watchful one, pressed out, goes into the filter; Soma, the all-beholding, moves onward among the gods.

sanskrit: sa naḥ pavasva vājayuś cakrāṇaś cārum adhvaram | barhiṣmām̐ ā vivāsati ||
english: Purify thyself for us, eager for food, fashioning the lovely sacrifice; thou seekest to illuminate the one who is rich in sacred grass.

sanskrit: sa no bhagāya vāyave vipravīraḥ sadāvṛdhaḥ | somo deveṣv ā yamat ||
english: Let that ever-growing Soma, whose heroes are inspired sages, reach to us among the gods for Bhaga and for Vāyu.

sanskrit: sa no adya vasuttaye kratuvid gātuvittamaḥ | vājaṁ jeṣi śravo bṛhat ||
english: He who knows the will, who knows the way most excellently — do thou today, for our obtaining of wealth, win for us food and great glory.

sanskrit: sa pavasva madāya kaṁ nṛcakṣā devavītaye | indav indrāya pītaye ||
english: Purify thyself, O soma drop, for gladdening delight — thou who seest mankind — for the enjoyment of the gods, for Indra to drink.

sanskrit: sa no arṣābhi dūtyaṁ tvam indrāya tośase | devān sakhibhya ā varam ||
english: Flow toward us on thy embassy to Indra for his satisfaction; bring the best gift from the gods to thy friends.

sanskrit: uta tvām aruṇaṁ vayaṁ gobhir añjmo madāya kam | vi no rāye duro vṛdhi ||
english: And we anoint thee, the ruddy one, with cows for gladdening delight; throw open wide for us the doors to wealth.

sanskrit: aty ū pavitram akramīd vājī dhuraṁ na yāmani | indur deveṣu patyate ||
english: The prize-winner has stepped forth beyond the filter like a chariot-horse on the march; the drop holds sway among the gods.

sanskrit: sam ī sakhāyo asvaran vane krīḻantam atyavim | induṁ nāvā anūṣata ||
english: The friends together have sung aloud — the drop that plays in the wood like an unruly ram; they have praised Indu with their boat-song.

sanskrit: tayā pavasva dhārayā yayā pīto vicakṣase | indo stotre suvīryam ||
english: Purify thyself with that stream by which, when drunk, thou art seen in thy glory; O Indu, bring heroic strength to the singer.

sanskrit: asṛgran devavītaye 'tyāsaḥ kṛtvyā iva | kṣarantaḥ parvatāvṛdhaḥ ||
english: They have rushed forth for the enjoyment of the gods — like strong ones performing their task — flowing, strengthened by the mountain-stones.

sanskrit: pariṣkṛtāsa indavo yoṣeva pitryāvatī | vāyuṁ somā asṛkṣata ||
english: The Indu-drops, adorned, like a maiden following her father, the Somas have been sent forth toward Vāyu.

sanskrit: ete somāsa indavaḥ prayasvantaś camū sutāḥ | indraṁ vardhanti karmabhiḥ ||
english: These Soma-drops, these Indus, pressed out in the two bowls, full of refreshment, magnify Indra by their deeds.

sanskrit: ā dhāvatā suhastyaḥ śukrā gṛbhṇīta manthinā | gobhiḥ śrīṇīta matsaram ||
english: O ye of skilful hands, run hither; seize the bright ones with the stirring-stick; blend the exhilarating juice with cows' milk.

sanskrit: sa pavasva dhanaṁjaya prayantā rādhaso mahaḥ | asmabhyaṁ soma gātuvit ||
english: Purify thyself, O conqueror of wealth, directing great bounty toward us; O Soma, knowing the path.

sanskrit: etam mṛjanti marjyam pavamānaṁ daśa kṣipaḥ | indrāya matsaram madam ||
english: The ten fingers polish this worthy one, the self-purifying Pavamāna — the exhilarating intoxicant for Indra.

sanskrit: ayā somaḥ sukṛtyayā mahaś cid abhy avardhata | mandāna ud vṛṣāyate ||
english: By this right action, Soma has grown great even beyond the great; gladdened, he roars like a bull.

sanskrit: kṛtānīd asya kartvā cetante dasyutarhaṇā | ṛṇā ca dhṛṣṇuś cayate ||
english: His deeds accomplished, ready to be done, his Dasyu-smiting powers are awakened; the bold one metes out debts in recompense.

sanskrit: āt soma indriyo raso vajraḥ sahasrasā bhuvat | ukthaṁ yad asya jāyate ||
english: So Soma, the invigorating essence, becomes a thousandfold-conquering thunderbolt when his praise-hymn is born.

sanskrit: svayaṁ kavir vidhartari viprāya ratnam icchati | yadī marmṛjyate dhiyaḥ ||
english: The seer himself, among those who dispense, seeks a gem for the inspired man — when the thoughts are polished well.

sanskrit: siṣāsatū rayīṇāṁ vājeṣv arvatām iva | bhareṣu jigyuṣām asi ||
english: Thou art one who desires to win riches — as horses in contests of speed; thou art the victor in the battles of givers.

sanskrit: taṁ tvā nṛmṇāni bibhrataṁ sadhastheṣu maho divaḥ | cāruṁ sukṛtyayemahe ||
english: Thee — bearing manly powers, lovely, in the dwelling-places of the great heaven — we call upon with right action.

sanskrit: saṁvṛktadhṛṣṇum ukthyam mahāmahivratam madam | śatam puro rurukṣaṇim ||
english: The bold one who draws all to himself, worthy of praise-hymns, the exhilarating rapture whose great vow is mighty — him who desires to break a hundred citadels.

sanskrit: atas tvā rayim abhi rājānaṁ sukrato divaḥ | suparṇo avyathir bharat ||
english: From yonder place, the well-winged one, undisturbed, O Sukratu, has brought thee — the king of heaven — bringing wealth.

sanskrit: viśvasmā it svar dṛśe sādhāraṇaṁ rajasturam | gopām ṛtasya vir bharat ||
english: The hero has brought the guardian of the sacred order — the light of the sun, common to all to behold, swiftly passing through the region of the air.

sanskrit: adhā hinvāna indriyaṁ jyāyo mahitvam ānaśe | abhiṣṭikṛd vicarṣaṇiḥ ||
english: Then, urging on the Indra-faculty, he has attained to a greatness that is still greater; the all-beholding one who creates conquest.

sanskrit: pavasva vṛṣṭim ā su no 'pām ūrmiṁ divas pari | ayakṣmā bṛhatīr iṣaḥ ||
english: Purify thyself, bringing rain for us, the wave of the waters from around heaven — bringing great refreshments free of disease.

sanskrit: tayā pavasva dhārayā yayā gāva ihāgaman | janyāsa upa no gṛham ||
english: Purify thyself with that stream by which the cattle have come hither — the kindred ones near to our house.

sanskrit: ghṛtam pavasva dhārayā yajñeṣu devavītamaḥ | asmabhyaṁ vṛṣṭim ā pava ||
english: Flow with a stream of ghee, thou most beloved of the gods at sacrifices; purify thyself bringing rain to us.

sanskrit: sa na ūrje vy avyayam pavitraṁ dhāva dhārayā | devāsaḥ śṛṇavan hi kam ||
english: For our strength, run through the imperishable filter with thy stream — for the gods shall surely hear.

sanskrit: pavamāno asiṣyadad rakṣāṁsy apajaṅghanat | pratnavad rocayan rucaḥ ||
english: Pavamāna has settled himself; he has kicked away the demons; he illumines his lights as of old.

sanskrit: ut te śuṣmāsa īrate sindhor ūrmer iva svanaḥ | vāṇasya codayā pavim ||
english: Thy vigours rise up like the sound of a wave of the river; urge forward the rim of the wheel of the lute-player.

sanskrit: prasave ta ud īrate tisro vāco makhasyuvaḥ | yad avya eṣi sānavi ||
english: At thy impulse, the three spirited voices rise up — when thou goest to the sheepskin ridges of the straining-cloth.

sanskrit: avyo vāre pari priyaṁ hariṁ hinvanty adribhiḥ | pavamānam madhuścutam ||
english: On the woollen filter, with the pressing-stones, they urge on the beloved tawny one — the self-purifying Pavamāna who drips with sweetness.

sanskrit: ā pavasva madintama pavitraṁ dhārayā kave | arkasya yonim āsadam ||
english: Flow into the filter with thy stream, O most exhilarating one, O Seer; take thy seat in the womb of the hymn.

sanskrit: sa pavasva madintama gobhir añjāno aktubhiḥ | indav indrāya pītaye ||
english: Purify thyself, O most exhilarating one, anointed with cows and with rays of light, O drop, for Indra to drink.
